features.name: Popup bridge protocol and runtime
features.description: Origin-verified popup handshake (HELLO/CONNECT/READY, protocol negotiation, session and instance ids), symmetric JSON-RPC 2.0 over MessageChannel with cancellation, timeouts and idempotency keys, contract-first type declarations and RPC generation utilities, revisioned event subscriptions, popup reload reconnection, and a real-Chromium cross-origin E2E that includes the COOP same-origin limitation. Also covers zero-copy transfers, heartbeat-based hang detection, inbound request and notification limits, and pageshow reconnection, plus the window network for popups that open popups: shared bridge nodes and peer links, attention requests (focus, title blink, notification, toast) with receiver-side policy and acknowledgements, topology and trace inspection, and revisioned shared state. Also covers optional protocol feature negotiation, per-event replay buffers with gap and reset fallback, event coalescing, and cancellable exponential reconnect backoff with jitter.
